chapter: Jazz at the Philharmonic and the record business
title: Back to the Stardust label question
summary: McGhee thinks the poorly pressed 'Stardust' came out on Melodisc rather than Modern.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: But the recording out in California was pretty good, so I don't understand how they got off-center. The Sunset records came out good.
Well, some of the Modern records came out good. But these particular ones didn't, for some reason.
Are you sure that was Modern? I think that "Stardust" was on another... Melodisc(?), I think it was.
Maybe it was. I don't know. I thought it was on Modern, but...
Because the Modern records like "Mad Hype" and those things, they were all right.
Yeah, they were all right. But the "Stardust" thing came out on Melodisk(?), I think that's what that was.
We'll have to check that out.
Yeah. I got here a tape of that, and it don't sound too good...
